assertions.name: A1_reproduces_legacy_frob_n3
assertions.source: the legacy FROB_N3 = m_e·(2 + 1/[2]_q) is exactly the A=1 case of this sum under the balanced normalisation — pin 1 for the q-integer convention

assertions.name: A6_matches_consumer_docstring_2p088
assertions.source: unified_low_isotope_predictor.term4_frobenius docstring: 'at A=6 it is 2.088' — pin 2; the unbalanced normalisation gives 2.0506 and a 6-row cap gives 1.0440, so this value discriminates both axes

assertions.name: A7_matches_consumer_docstring_2p060
assertions.source: same docstring: 'at A=7 the actual value is 2.060' — pin 2

assertions.name: extreme_block_row_dim_q_is_one
assertions.source: dim_q((n)) = 1: a single row's hooks are n, n-1, …, 1, so the hook product IS [n]_q! — convention-free, pin 3

assertions.name: extreme_block_column_dim_q_is_one
assertions.source: dim_q((1^n)) = 1 by conjugation symmetry of the hook multiset

assertions.name: decays_monotonically_toward_two
assertions.source: Σ is strictly decreasing for A ≥ 3 (min successive difference > 0), approaching 2 from above since the two extreme blocks contribute 1 each — the behaviour the consumer's fallback constant 2.05 was estimating

description: Σ_{λ⊢3A} 1/dim_q(λ) at the substrate q₀ for A = 1..8, the term-4 Frobenius co-Casimir table consumed by unified_low_isotope_predictor.term4_frobenius and mass_formula_6term. dim_q is the quantum hook-length formula [n]_q!/∏[h_x]_q with the BALANCED q-integer [h]_q = (q^h − q^-h)/(q − q^-1), summed over ALL partitions of 3A with no row cap. Both of those choices are pinned by existing corpus values rather than selected here — see the assertions. Parameter-free: a finite combinatorial sum at q₀, no experimental input.
caveats: A ≥ 9 is not tabulated. p(27) = 3010 and the cost grows quickly; the consumers index A ≤ 7, and A = 8 is included only to check the monotone-decay assertion one rung past the table. A consumer above A = 8 still falls back to its asymptotic constant.

This table does NOT validate that term 4 belongs in the binding formula, only that the quantity the formula names is computed as named. unified_low_isotope_predictor's other terms are unaffected, and its B_pred remains far from AME (bean qou-syit).
